extension.summary: Google Drive as a Kodi WebDAV source
extension.description: GDrive Bridge serves your Google Drive (My Drive, Shared with me, Shared drives and Starred) to Kodi as a read-only WebDAV source on this device. Add dav://127.0.0.1:8765/ as a video, music or pictures source and Kodi browses, scans and plays it like any network share. Live slideshow shows a Drive folder and picks up new photos as they arrive. Set it up from any phone, tablet or computer: open the add-on, scan the QR code and follow the steps. It signs in with your own Google Cloud client, so nothing passes through anyone else's server.
